zh: 周记 · 第 {week} 周
en: Journal · Week {week}

zh: 自己 / 朋友 / 生活 / 地球 / {player}
en: Me / Friends / Life / Earth / {player}

zh: 我第一次自己排课。机械课好难，可是我没有哭。
en: I made my own schedule for the first time. Mechanics is super hard, but I didn't cry.

zh: 温室里的番茄苗。我每天跟它说早安。
en: The tomato seedling in the greenhouse. I say good morning to it every day.

zh: 早上灯会变黄，晚上灯会变蓝。我知道那不是真的天，可是我喜欢。
en: In the morning the lights turn yellow, and at night they turn blue. I know it's not the real sky, but I like it.

zh: 我看了实时画面，地球是灰色的。可是我还是觉得，有一棵绿色的树躲起来了。
en: I looked at the live feed. Earth is gray. But I still think there's a green tree hiding somewhere.

zh: {player}说我今天做得很好。我要记下来。
en: {player} said I did really good today. I'm writing it down.

zh: 我会开机器人了！在游戏里。
en: I can drive a robot now! In the game.

zh: ARK-01 走路摇摇晃晃的，还没有名字。我要想一个好听的。
en: ARK-01 wobbles when it walks, and it doesn't have a name yet. I'm gonna think of a good one.

zh: 我画了维修站修好的样子，还录了话给明天的我。不告诉别人说了什么。
en: I drew the repair station all fixed up, and I recorded a message for tomorrow me. It's a secret what I said.

zh: 游戏里的小镇也是灰灰的。做游戏的人肯定也看过窗外。
en: The town in the game is all gray too. The people who made the game must've looked out the window too.

zh: {player}陪我把一整片地都清干净了。
en: {player} helped me clean up a whole big area.

zh: 我给它起名字了，叫{ark}！
en: I gave it a name! It's {ark}!

zh: {ark}，还有第三台机器人。它躺了好久，现在能站起来了。
en: {ark}, and the third robot too. It was lying down for so long, and now it can stand up.

zh: 种植区开了。我要种好多好多东西。
en: The planting plot is open. I'm gonna grow lots and lots of stuff.

zh: 小叶子是绿色的！跟方舟温室里的一样绿！
en: The little leaf is green! Just as green as the ones in the Ark greenhouse!

zh: {player}说我照顾得很好。小叶子也是{player}的。
en: {player} said I took really good care of it. The little leaf is {player}'s too.

zh: 这周第一次由我来定方案。说出来之前，我紧张得把平板按亮了三次。
en: This week was the first time I got to decide the plan. Before I said it, I was so nervous I turned my tablet on three times.

zh: 工业区大门打开的时候，{ark}被灰盖了一身。我在屏幕这边也跟着用力。
en: When the industrial zone gate opened, {ark} got covered in dust. I was straining right along with it on my side of the screen.

zh: 课排得很满，但我不想少上一节。
en: My schedule is packed, but I don't want to skip a single lesson.

zh: 很久没开实时画面了。小时候我以为能找到一棵绿树，现在知道没那么简单。
en: I haven't opened the live feed in a long time. When I was little I thought I'd find a green tree. Now I know it's not that simple.

zh: {player}没有直接说好，先问了我为什么。我喜欢这样。
en: {player} didn't just say yes. They asked me why first. I like that.

zh: 有人在动我的东西。我要自己查清楚。
en: Someone's been messing with my stuff. I'm going to figure it out myself.

zh: {ark}的脚印旁边，多了一串不是它的脚印。
en: Next to {ark}'s tracks, there's a trail of tracks that aren't its own.

zh: 这周睡得不好，一直在想那个坏掉的滤芯。
en: I didn't sleep well this week. I kept thinking about that broken filter.

zh: 档案里说，旧时代的人上地面要戴面罩。游戏的设定也做得这么细吗？
en: The archives say people in the old days had to wear masks on the surface. Is the game really that detailed?

zh: 我问{player}这是不是隐藏任务。我想自己找到答案。
en: I asked {player} if this is a hidden quest. I want to find the answer myself.

zh: 在温室门口，我差点没敢进去。
en: At the greenhouse door, I almost didn't dare go in.

zh: 那个人。他不像 NPC。
en: That person. He doesn't seem like an NPC.

zh: 这几天，我吃饭的时候都在想他。
en: These past few days, I keep thinking about him at every meal.

zh: 我又开了实时画面，看了很久。
en: I opened the live feed again and looked for a long time.

zh: {player}一直在。这就够了。
en: {player}'s always here. That's enough.

zh: 温室没进去。下次我想自己决定。
en: We didn't go into the greenhouse. Next time I want to decide for myself.

zh: {ark}在温室门外站了很久，像是在等什么。
en: {ark} stood outside the greenhouse for a long time, like it was waiting for something.

zh: 这周过得很慢。
en: This week went by slowly.

zh: 做这个游戏的人，为什么要做得这么大？
en: Why would whoever made this game make it so big?

zh: {player}，你说温室里到底有什么？
en: {player}, what do you think is really inside the greenhouse?

zh: 在清洁的土壤上种植。需要水。

zh: 修复旧温室

zh: 修复 C 区的玻璃温室，阻挡外部花粉。需要水和电。

en: Repair the Audio Transceiver

en: Repairs ARK-01's audio module so it can send and receive sound.

en: Ark Handbook · Children's Edition: An illustrated guide to the Ark's modules.

zh: 《植物图鉴》：灾难前地球常见植物的图鉴。书页边上画满了小星星。
en: Field Guide to Plants: Common plants of pre-disaster Earth. The margins are covered in little stars.

zh: 《地面应急指南》：旧时代地面基地的工作手册。书签夹在"防护装备"一章。
en: Surface Emergency Guide: An operations manual for old-era surface bases. The bookmark is in the chapter on protective equipment.

en: An open reading workbook.

zh: 一本翻开的笔记本，写满了《重建计划》的建造方案。
en: An open notebook filled with construction plans for Project Rebuild.
